Architecture

Plex ODBC views are copied into BigQuery raw_* tables by one Cloud Run job per pipeline, then each pipeline's bq_view list is created on top of them. The probe decides whether a run needs to extract at all.

Prod vs Test

Same image, same code, two environments that run differently. Prod is started by the dispatcher and uses the probe to skip runs when Plex has not changed. Test is started once a night by Cloud Scheduler and always extracts in full: its probe is computed and logged but never allowed to skip.

Schedules

Prod times live in PlexOps.etl_schedule and are started by the etl-dispatcher function. Change a prod time with SQL, not Terraform. Test jobs keep their own nightly Cloud Scheduler entries and never go through the dispatcher.
